sloka: भर्त्सितामपि याचध्वं राक्षस्यः किं विवक्षया ।राघवाद्धि भयं घोरं राक्षसानामुपस्थितम् ।। ५.२७.४३।।।।
transliteration: bhartsitāmapi yācadhvaṁ rākṣasyaḥ kiṁ vivakṣayā ।rāghavāddhi bhayaṁ ghoraṁ rākṣasānāmupasthitam ।। 5.27.43।।।।

translations.english: "O demonesses beg her (pardon) now even though you had threatened her earlier. Where is the need to hesitate? There is cause for concern for demons from Rama.
